create_Dataset_for_qa: create a Dataset instance to load QA examples with context passages and scoring
use_Collator_for_batching: use the Collator class to tokenize and batch QA examples with target answers
load_data_from_json: load data from a JSON or JSONL file with optional distributed shard splitting
encode_passages_with_tokenizer: encode a batch of text passages into token IDs and attention masks
use_RetrieverCollator_for_retrieval: use the RetrieverCollator to tokenize questions and passages with retrieval scores
